title: Samsung's $1B AI-Infrastructure Bet (KKR/Nvidia Helix Digital)
summary: Gotrade News - Samsung and five of its affiliates have committed $1 billion to Helix Digital Infrastructure, an AI infrastructure company formed by KKR &

Samsung said the investment would help support the global rollout of AI data centers while creating collaboration opportunities among the participating affiliates, per Reuters via Investing.com.


## Helix CEO Calls Samsung Deal a Vote of Confidence


Selipsky, Helix's co-founder and CEO, framed the deal as validation of the company's approach in a statement released with the announcement.


> "Samsung's commitment is a strong vote of confidence in Helix's strategy and further deepens the long-term capital base we've built to meet the scale of AI infrastructure demand." (Adam Selipsky, CEO and Co-Founder, Helix)


For KKR, the deal adds to a digital infrastructure and power portfolio that the firm says exceeds $75 billion in investments globally, and to roughly $9 billion it says it has invested in Korea across strategies, according to the release.
